project.name: cavet
project.description: A Go CLI security-triage tool for coding agents. It runs scanners (trivy, opengrep, gitleaks, checkov) inside an offline container engine and records every finding and decision in an append-only audit log.
project.context: This finding comes from a scan of the cavet repository itself.

finding.description:
generic-api-key has detected secret for file scripts/smoke.ps1 at commit 2d0fd8e0ad93e3516b4dcf9e879834852fd60c7f.
verdict: dismissed (high confidence, by operator): synthetic 48-char alphanumeric literal defined at scripts/smoke.ps1 line 34 (comment lines 32-33) solely to make gitleaks generic-api-key fire in the smoke test; it is written only into a throwaway temp repo and maps to no real service or account
